_comment: INDUSTRIAL: a deck winch - a bed plate, two cradle cheeks, a cable drum lying along +Z and an eight-sided cog proud of one flank. The cog is the kit's exclusive wheels-and-cogs class: exposed gearing is machinery a warship would armour over and a sold ship would fair over, so only the builders show it. Eight sides on the cog is deliberate - at hull distance a faceted disc reads as a gear where a rounder one reads as a wheel. The crank knob on the cog face is the kit's yellow in its HANDLE use, the hatch handle's paint - the accent stays a system. Drum axis is +Z so `align: Run` lays the machinery with the deck grain beside its fitting.
